meta.name: seo-content-brief
meta.description: Generate a writer-ready SEO content brief from a target domain and topic. Pulls domain overview, competitors, keyword gaps, SERP analysis, related and question keywords, AI Search citations, and existing internal-link sources, then synthesises a complete editorial brief a freelance writer can start from immediately. Use when the user asks for a content brief, blog brief, article outline, editor brief, or wants to capture organic traffic their competitors have.

copy.tagline: 从目标主题生成一份可直接交付给写手的SEO内容简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速产出结构完整、关键词覆盖到位的文章简报来指导写手创作。
